Ashford Capital Management Increases Holding in Rogers (ROG); Adobe Systems (ADBE) Holder Saturna Capital Cut Position 
April 1, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Ashford Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Rogers Corp (ROG) by 7.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ashford Capital Management Inc bought 2,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.12% with the market. The hedge fund held 35,334 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.72 million, up from 32,934 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ashford Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Rogers Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.19B market cap company. The stock increased 1.57% or $1.85 during the last trading session, reaching $119.54. About 229,998 shares traded or 27.00% up from the average. Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) has risen 45.81% since April 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 34.26% the S&P500. 
Saturna Capital Corp decreased its stake in Adobe Systems (ADBE) by 9.34% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
